تجتذبن (form VIII)
# تَجْتَذِبْنَ (tajtaḏibna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ðib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# تُجْتَذَبْنَ (tujtaḏabna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ðab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
